note: Granulocyte: granulocytes (predominantly neutrophils and eosinophils; basophils fall into the residual downstream) — large blob on the right (CD66 high, CD45 low-to-high). CD45hiCD66lo: mononuclear fraction (lymphocytes, monocytes, DCs, NK) — blob at the upper-left (CD45 high, CD66 low). The two populations occupy opposite corners of the plot; sparse events at the lower-left and the upper-right are excluded.
tips: Granulocyte: CD45low/int CD66+ (neutrophils typically show CD45 low-to-intermediate and dominate this gate; basophils express CD66 at very low levels and are generally NOT captured in a CD66+ granulocyte gate). CD45hiCD66lo: CD45hi CD66-. Useful co-markers: CD16_Tb159Di further confirms neutrophils within Granulocyte (neutrophils CD16+, eosinophils CD16-); CD11b_Eu153Di is positive on both neutrophils and eosinophils and reinforces granulocyte identity; CD33_Nd142Di (pan-myeloid) is typically low-to-intermediate on granulocytes vs higher on monocytes and can help distinguish myeloid vs lymphoid within the CD45hiCD66lo fraction; HLA-DR_Yb176Di is negative on granulocytes; CD3_Gd157Di / CD19_Yb173Di low confirms non-lymphoid nature of CD45hiCD66lo minor populations.
